summary: The Hetzner Robot storage box API was sunset on July 30, 2025 and community.hrobot storagebox modules needed updates; the new API requires an API token passed as hetzner_token.
questions: Do community.hrobot storagebox modules work with Hetzner's new API?
What credentials do I need for Hetzner storage boxes in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Hetzner storage box API change
answer_card.answer_md: The Hetzner Robot API for storage boxes was deprecated and sunset on **July 30, 2025**. At Ansible 12.0.0 the community.hrobot storagebox modules were not yet compatible with the new API, and usage and return values might change slightly. The new API requires a registered API token passed as `hetzner_token`.
